title: Behavioral CCC: A Behavioral Structure Paradigm for Intelligent Systems
description: Behavioral CCC (Behavioral Common Concept Core) proposes a structural paradigm for modeling behavior and decision trajectories in intelligent systems. While modern AI architectures—such as large language model reasoning, AI coding assistants, autonomous agents, and rule-based systems—often appear fundamentally different, they share a common structural pattern: the selection of behavioral trajectories under goals and constraints. The Behavioral CCC framework extends Structural Intelligence from static knowledge structures to dynamic behavior structures, providing a unified interpretation of diverse AI systems and rule-based decision processes.
